card.name: UI-RB-06 — Compact deck density from actual app references
card.description:
HTML206 — 19 October2026. Jason rejected empty deck space in205. Investigated actual installed rekordbox4Deck Vertical, Traktor Mixer→Essential and header-size cycling through Full/Advanced/Micro/Small, and Serato's current disconnected2deck view. Native screenshots retained privately. Traktor restored to original Mixer layout. Rekordbox PAD toggle attempts produced no observed change; do not claim that collapse state inspected. Serato hardware-dependent Stack view unavailable while disconnected; official Display Modes documentation distinguishes Extended/Library/Stack. No claim every vendor has one identically named Compact mode.

Root cause: compact deck rows were tied to the mixer/waveform row height. Implemented content-sized compact deck consoles, paired36px Play/CUE,24px mode selector,88px loop/control band,44px header/24px overview, same utilities/footer. Four-deck Vertical now lets the center mixer span the shorter deck rows independently. Two-deck Horizontal Compact reuses the observed mirrored trim/CUE/fader beside EQ arrangement. Full layout preserved; no new core-control hiding. Original filter-row omission from203 unchanged.

Executed actual HTML at1440CSS px/default Medium waveform:2H268→224px,2V292→240px,4H/4V268→224px per deck; library starts44/52/88/88px earlier respectively. Normal Compact H/V2/4:72/144 selected core deck nodes visible/contained, rotary hit boxes nonoverlapping, crossfader center0px; mixer hide/show, Pads→Full→Compact and Small/Large wave-size branches exercised. Wave sizes can intentionally increase deck height. No new audible/hardware/DSP tests for CSS. Visual acceptance pending.

Evidence docs/prototype/COMPACT_DECKS_206.md/.json and docs/research/COMPACT_LAYOUT_REFERENCES_206.md; local-evidence/compact-decks-206/ private native/HTML images and geometry. Build plan/Claude handoffs synchronized. HTML/CSS only: no native rebuild; existing app/engine/MIDI/waveform JS and native0.1.27 ASAR unchanged. Related UI-RB-04 https://trello.com/c/Rx4NWhjG and CORE-001.

AI recommendations retained: Codex gpt-6.1-sol/high for focused UI/state work; Claude Code Sonnet5/medium for reference/layout review, verify live availability before invoking. Escalate only a reproduced state/overlap/core-control regression. No agents launched. Scope: core DJ HTML review; do not resume advanced features or integrate native until Jason approves.
